svg.title: coderprint: 602k lines of code in use, of 785k written, all time
svg.desc: 602,458 lines of code in use (429,084 in production, 173,374 in tests), of 784,825 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 1,552 commits across all branches, 38 active days, a longest streak of 23 days, a current streak of 0 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 709k lines of code. The bars end on 01OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 42%, Lean 32%, Python 11%, TypeScript 10%, JavaScript 5%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 77% is kept.
